description: Take-home pay for an employee in one of 16 countries (India, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Greece, Spain, Romania, Bulgaria, China, Poland, Turkey, Morocco, Belgium, Italy, Indonesia) from a gross yearly salary in that country's currency, 2026 rules: income tax and employee social contributions, itemised, also in euros. Each country models one standard situation (single, no children, a named city or region where taxes differ), stated in the result.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: IN, US, GB, DE, FR, GR, ES, RO, BG, CN, PL, TR, MA, BE, IT, ID

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many units of the local currency, for the euro amounts. Default: an indicative rate; ignored for euro countries.

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the country's own currency

name: net_salary_abroad
title: Net salary in another country
